QuestInfo.name: [Title] Pretty on the Inside
QuestInfo.0: There seems to be special title that can only be obtained in Battle Mode. Go to Maximus the knight and find out what that is.
QuestInfo.1: It's not only the strong who are attractive. It appears that the #bPretty on the Inside#k title can be obtained through Battle Mode. How? Not even Maximus knows! Looks like it's up to you to find out!
QuestInfo.2: You received a title from Maximus.

0.0: There are all kinds of titles you can get in Battle Mode. You ever see anybody with a #bPretty on the Inside#k title? Some folks manage to be attractive, even though they get knocked out by a gust of wind.
0.1: What do you think? Do you feel #bPretty on the Inside#k? You gonna take the challenge?

yes.0: Too bad for you, I don't have any idea how to get that title. I'm pretty all over.

no.0: Not into glory and fame and being recognized as the best, huh? Can't say I'm surprised...

1.0: You really ARE Pretty on the Inside... Not my favorite, but it works for you.

default.0: Think you're #bPretty on the Inside#k? Better take on the challenge!
